## Goal
Build the public hook context and normalize hook return values, warnings, thrown errors, artifact writes, and issue-log candidates.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Artifact helpers write under specs/<specId>/plugin-artifacts/<pluginId>/.
- Public context excludes raw flowManager and other core internal objects.

## Implementation Notes

## Test Strategy
